title: QUIC internal server 0-RTT opening verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home tests with positive, negative, replay, forbidden-frame, and fuzz-shaped coverage; benchmark lane for server ZeroRtt packet opening; followed by SpecTrace, build, full-suite, and diff validation.
scope: Verify the internal managed-server early-data path from ticket advertisement through admitted server ZeroRtt packet opening and bounded application delivery while preserving closed public support and interop classification.
preconditions: Internal managed server resumption tickets are enabled.
Internal server early data is enabled.
A detached ticket carries early-data prerequisite material and remembered 0-RTT transport parameters.
The listener-local ticket store contains the matching live server-issued ticket.
procedure: Run the focused REQ-QUIC-CRT-0153 requirement-home tests.
Confirm server early-data ticket issuance adds the TLS early_data extension with max_early_data_size 0xffffffff and stores remembered 0-RTT parameters.
Confirm eligible clients offer zero-length ClientHello early_data before pre_shared_key and preserve binder validation.
Confirm admitted same-listener attempts publish server ZeroRtt open material and EncryptedExtensions early_data.
Confirm disabled server early data and replayed tickets do not publish ZeroRtt open material.
Confirm the runtime opens an authenticated Version 1 ZeroRtt STREAM packet and delivers bytes to the stream registry.
Confirm forbidden 0-RTT ACK frames trigger a local protocol violation without delivering stream data.
Repeat randomized authenticated STREAM payloads through the 0-RTT opener.
Run nearby 0-RTT/resumption homes, SpecTrace core validation, Release build, full Release tests, and diff check.
expected_result: The internal server early-data path admits only validated, listener-local, anti-replay-approved tickets, opens server ZeroRtt packets, delivers bounded STREAM/PING/PADDING early data, rejects forbidden 0-RTT frames, and leaves public API, IsSupported, HTTP/3, and interop zerortt classification unchanged.

supplemental_sections.heading: Acceptance Criteria
supplemental_sections.content:
- Server early-data ticket issuance advertises the QUIC max_early_data_size sentinel only with remembered 0-RTT parameters.
- ClientHello early_data is zero-length and appears before the final pre_shared_key extension.
- Server ZeroRtt open material and EncryptedExtensions early_data appear only after PSK validation and listener-local admission.
- Disabled early data and replayed tickets fail closed.
- Runtime delivery is bounded to STREAM/PING/PADDING and forbidden 0-RTT frames are rejected.
- Public support surfaces and interop inventory remain conservative.

status_summary: Passed locally for focused REQ-QUIC-CRT-0153 coverage with 6/6 tests passing and the surrounding REQ-QUIC-CRT-0149 through REQ-QUIC-CRT-0153 plus interop dry-run homes with 30/30 tests passing. SpecTrace core validation passed for 532 JSON artifacts, Release build completed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, the full Release no-build test rerun passed 4,889/4,889, and git diff --check exited 0 with only line-ending normalization warnings.
